title: For small children
text: It is a very good experience for children up to 10 years old, I would say. I went with my 11-year-old son and he already found it too much for small children. Exclusive for children familiar with the characters from TV3's Club Super 3, especially those who are fans of MIC and Titó. There were several broken or non-functioning sets, which is a bit disappointing for being so new. They have a locker service and a place to leave strollers. Super clean bathrooms. Very friendly staff.
author: Ninnibcn
